headline: LAA @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 3.81 at TBR 5.03, with a projected total of 8.85. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAA moved +0.54 runs while TBR moved -0.85, changing the projected margin by +1.39 runs. The projected total fell -0.31, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shane McClanahan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yandy Díaz, Jonathan Aranda, Junior Caminero, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Taylor Walls because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
